title: Sanity Details, Clash Arena E.G.O, minor fixes

texts: Added Sanity Details to identities in the identity database.

Added E.G.O support to Clash Arena. E.G.O are toggleable and are drafted after Identities. They also cost between 1-10 points, but players are only given half the usual points per round (rounded up). Only one E.G.O can be drafted, and it only has one use throughout the game. Both the Awakening and Corrosion versions share the same single use.
Prevented the text on the bonus toggles in Identity and E.G.O pages from unnecessarily wrapping on shorter named items.
Centered the text underneath assets in the Community Assets page.
Added keywords to the modal when expanding assets in the Community Assets page.
